Before You Book

Important Things to Know Before Renting a Tempo Traveller

Plan Your Group Travel with Confidence

Before booking a Tempo Traveller or 33-seater bus rental with Abhi Cabs 24×7, consider these details:

  • Passenger Count: Select the appropriate seating capacity for your group.
  • Luggage Space: Check baggage requirements, especially for long-distance trips.
  • Vehicle Amenities: Confirm AC availability, seating configuration, and other facilities.
  • Trip Duration: Specify whether you need a one-day, hourly, or multi-day rental.
  • Rental Charges: Review the applicable rate, minimum kilometres, and extra-distance charges.
  • Tolls & Parking: Confirm toll fees, parking charges, permits, and applicable taxes.
  • Driver Allowance: Check whether driver-related charges are included in the quoted fare.
  • Route Accessibility: Check vehicle restrictions and destination access for larger vehicles.
  • Cancellation Terms: Review the applicable cancellation and rescheduling policies.
